findingDetails.title: Oversized commit messages can hide forbidden trailers from every gate
findingDetails.evidence: validateCommit slices messages above 200,000 characters before its rule scans; the template forbids Co-Authored-By and the shared validator is called by commit-msg, pre-push, the agent gate and CI.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject over-limit messages instead of truncating the unvalidated suffix.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The shared message-contract module declares all gates use this validator; commit-msg and pre-push call validate-message.mjs, and CI invokes its commit-range mode.

noveltyJustification: The truncation boundary exposes a new shared enforcement bypass affecting all commit-message gates.

ruledOut.reason: All inspected gates call the same template-backed validator.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The validated manifest contains 1,997 existing paths; this pass traced a shared security gate across runtime and CI callers.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Security review traced the message-length bound through the shared validator and every inspected enforcement route.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A message suffix past the input cap can contain a forbidden trailer that no validation pass sees.

searchActions.result: The message is sliced at 200,000 characters before forbidden-attribution checks scan body lines.
The contract forbids Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session trailers and vendor-attribution values.

searchLedger.rationale: The validator accepts only the truncated prefix, so valid-looking content before the cap masks a prohibited trailer after it.

searchLedger.invariant: Commit-time, pre-push, agent and CI gates apply the same rule implementation.

searchActions.result: Every inspected enforcement route calls the same validateCommit implementation through validate-message.mjs.

searchLedger.rationale: No independent validator bypasses or strengthens the truncated shared check in these inspected callers.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The entry points converge on one shared validator.
